# Interface How-To — QA phase

<!-- GENERATED by src/tests/exploration/gen-howto.ts — do not edit by hand.
     Requests derive from the tested exploration bindings; responses + MCP
     schemas from .out/howto-capture.json; option tables from @Option /
     inputSchema / @ApiProperty. exploration.spec.ts fails CI on drift. -->

Validate quality gates and downstream-phase artifact completeness.

**Envelope:** every response is an ADR-0073 envelope `{ success, data | error: { code, message }, meta }`.
**Exit codes (CLI):** `0` on a passing verdict, non-zero on a failing verdict or error.
**Mutative MCP tools** require `{ "apply": true, "approvalToken": "…" }` (the dispatch gates them; `RULESET_NOT_FOUND` etc. are consistent across surfaces).
**Reading the response blocks:** they are the SHAPE of what the interface really returned, not a sample of data. Every field name is real and every value carries its type — `"<string>"`, `"<number>"` — because what a rule counts or a gate decides depends on the workspace being evaluated, not on the interface. An array is shown as a single element merging every element observed. Values that ARE the contract are printed literally: `success`, `command`/`tool`, the error `code`, and `schemaVersion`.

Operations in this phase: `validate-satellite`, `composable-validate`, `phase-artifacts-evaluate`, `gate-evaluate`, `dora-metrics`.

---
### Validate satellite compliance

> `validate-satellite` — Validate a satellite repository against Evolith governance standards

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli validate`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --format [string]` | Formato de salida (json, table, yaml, markdown) |
| `-o, --output [string]` | Ruta para guardar el reporte JSON |
| `-s, --satellite [path]` | Ruta al repositorio satélite (default: cwd) |
| `-c, --core [path]` | Ruta al repositorio Evolith Core (default: auto-detect) |
| `--select <ref>` | Evaluar SOLO el/los ruleset(s) indicados, por el ref que publica  |
| `-r, --ruleset [id]` | Validar ruleset específico (adr-0002, acl, open-core, inheritance, cli-release, cli-parity, evidence, mcp, observability) |
| `-a, --arch` | Validar arquitectura sobre todo el eje progresivo (equivale a las tres topologías progresivas) |
| `-t, --topology [id]` | Topología canónica a validar (repetible): modular-monolith, distributed-modules,  |
| `-e, --engine [engine]` | Motor de validación a utilizar: native (por defecto) u opa |
| `--max-skipped-fraction <fraction>` | Suelo de cobertura: falla si la fracción de reglas aplicables NO evaluadas supera este valor (0..1).  |
| `-m, --manifest [path]` | Ruta al SatelliteManifest JSON para evaluación end-to-end (activa pipeline GT-281) |
| `-p, --phase [phase]` | Fase SDLC a evaluar: discovery, design, construction, qa, release. Activa pipeline GT-281 |
| `--adr [id]` | Validar contra reglas ADR específicas (adr-0002, adr-0005, adr-0010, adr-0018, adr-0032, adr-0040, adr-0050) |
| `--file [path]` | Validar archivo individual (modo ad-hoc) |
| `--composable` | Usar motor de validación composable (GT-312) con resolución inteligente de modos |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli validate --satellite /abs/path/to/your-satellite --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --format json
```

#### MCP
Tool: `evolith-validate`

| Argument | Type | Req. | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | ✓ | Path to the satellite repository |
| `format` | string |  | Output format (json, summary, table) |
| `ruleset` | string |  | Optional ID of a specific ruleset to load |
| `select` | array |  | Canonical ruleset refs to evaluate against, as published by GET /api/v1/reference/rulesets. Absent => the whole corpus. |
| `corePath` | string |  | Optional explicit path to the Evolith core repository |
| `topology` | string |  | Topology to target (auto-detects from manifest if omitted). Triggers end-to-end pipeline. |
| `phase` | string |  | SDLC phase to evaluate: discovery|design|construction|qa|release. Triggers end-to-end pipeline. |
| `manifest` | string |  | JSON string or path to SatelliteManifest for pipeline evaluation. Overrides path/topology/phase. |
| `maxSkippedFraction` | number |  | Coverage floor: fail when the fraction of applicable rules that did NOT run exceeds this value (0..1). Absent => no floor. |

  "name": "evolith-validate",

    "path": "/abs/path/to/your-satellite",
    "corePath": "/abs/path/to/evolith-core"

}

### Measure downstream-phase artifact completeness

> `phase-artifacts-evaluate` — Measure downstream-phase artifact completeness for a topology composition (advisory, non-binding; ADR-0104 / DN-06 / GT-434)

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli topology phase-artifacts`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-c, --core <path>` | Path to the Evolith core repository (default: profile.core or cwd) |
| `-p, --phase <phase>` | Downstream SDLC phase: construction | quality | deployment |
| `-t, --topologies <list>` | Confirmed topology composition (comma-separated ids), e.g. microservices,event-driven |
| `-d, --declared <list>` | Artifact kinds declared as present (comma-separated), e.g. test-summary-report,coverage-report |
| `-f, --format <string>` | Output format: json (ADR-0073 envelope) or human (default) |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli topology phase-artifacts --phase construction --topologies modular-monolith --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --format json
```
Response shape (captured live):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "completeness": "<number>",
    "conditionalArtifacts": [],
    "missingArtifacts": [
      "<string>"
    ],
    "phase": "<string>",
    "presentArtifacts": [],
    "requiredArtifacts": [
      "<string>"
    ]
  },
  "meta": {
    "command": "evolith topology phase-artifacts",
    "correlationId": "<string>",
    "durationMs": "<number>",
    "executedAt": "<string>",
    "schemaVersion": "1.0.0"
  },
  "success": true
}
```

#### MCP
Tool: `evolith-phase-artifacts-evaluate`

| Argument | Type | Req. | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phase` | string | ✓ | Downstream SDLC phase |
| `topologies` | array | ✓ | Confirmed topology composition (ids) |
| `declaredArtifacts` | array |  | Artifact kinds the consumer declares as present |
| `corePath` | string |  | Optional explicit path to the Evolith core repository |

Example (`tools/call`):

  "name": "evolith-phase-artifacts-evaluate",

}

### Phase gate evaluation

> `gate-evaluate` — Evaluate a specific SDLC phase gate (discovery/design/construction/qa/release) and emit GateEvidence

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli gate evaluate`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --phase <phase>` | SDLC phase: discovery, design, construction, qa, release |
| `-s, --satellite [path]` | Satellite project path (default: nearest-ancestor evolith.yaml from cwd) |
| `--project [path]` | [deprecated] Alias for --satellite (ADR-0109) |
| `-c, --core [path]` | Evolith Core path (default: auto-detect) |
| `-f, --format [string]` | Output format: json (ADR-0073 envelope) or human (default) |
| `--evaluated-by [actor]` | Actor class: human (default), agent, ci |
| `--initiative [id]` | Opaque initiative context, echoed in meta.context |
| `--tenant [id]` | Opaque tenant context, echoed in meta.context |
| `--webhook-url <url>` | URL to POST the gate evidence upon completion |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli gate evaluate --phase discovery --project /abs/path/to/your-satellite --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --evaluated-by ci --format json
```
Response shape (captured live):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "evaluatedAt": "<string>",
    "evaluatedBy": "<string>",
    "gateId": "<string>",
    "phase": "<string>",
    "rulesetRef": "<string>",
    "rulesetVersion": "<string>",
    "verdict": "<string>",
    "violations": [
      {
        "location": "<string>",
        "message": "<string>",
        "ruleId": "<string>",
        "severity": "<string>"
      }
    ]
  },
  "meta": {
    "command": "evolith gate evaluate",
    "context": {
      "phase": "<string>"
    },
    "correlationId": "<string>",
    "durationMs": "<number>",
    "executedAt": "<string>",
    "schemaVersion": "1.0.0"
  },
  "success": true
}
```

#### MCP
Tool: `evolith-gate-evaluate`

| Argument | Type | Req. | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phase` | string | ✓ | Phase identifier (discovery, design, construction, qa, release) |
| `projectPath` | string | ✓ | Path to the repository to validate |
| `corePath` | string |  | Optional explicit path to the Evolith Core repository (source of the SDLC gate definitions). Required when the server does not run beside a Core checkout. |
| `rulesetRef` | string |  | Optional ruleset reference |
| `evidenceMode` | string |  | full or summary |
| `evaluatedBy` | string |  | human, agent, or ci |
| `initiative` | string |  | Optional initiative context |
| `tenant` | string |  | Optional tenant context |

Example (`tools/call`):
```json
{
  "name": "evolith-gate-evaluate",
  "arguments": {
    "phase": "discovery",
    "projectPath": "/abs/path/to/your-satellite",
    "corePath": "/abs/path/to/evolith-core",
    "evaluatedBy": "ci"
  }
}
```
Response shape (captured live):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "evaluatedAt": "<string>",
    "evaluatedBy": "<string>",
    "gateId": "<string>",
    "phase": "<string>",
    "rulesetRef": "<string>",

    "verdict": "<string>",
    "violations": [
      {
        "location": "<string>",
        "message": "<string>",
        "ruleId": "<string>",
        "severity": "<string>"
      }
    ]
  },
  "meta": {
    "command": "evolith-gate-evaluate",

      "phase": "<string>"
    },
    "correlationId": "<string>",
    "durationMs": "<number>",
    "executedAt": "<string>",
    "schemaVersion": "1.0.0",
    "timestamp": "<string>",
    "tool": "evolith-gate-evaluate"
  },
  "success": true
}
```

### DORA metrics

> `dora-metrics` — Calculate DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for changes) from Git history

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli sdlc gate-status`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--since <days>` | Days of git history to analyse for DORA metrics (default: 90) |
| `-f, --format <string>` | Output format: json (ADR-0073 envelope) or human (default) |
| `-c, --core [path]` | Path to the Evolith Core checkout that holds the canonical SDLC gates (default: auto-detect) |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli sdlc gate-status --since 90 --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --format json
```
Response shape (captured live):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "doraMetrics": null,
    "gateStatus": {
      "currentPhase": "<number>",
      "gatesFailed": "<number>",
      "gatesPassed": "<number>",
      "gatesPending": "<number>",
      "results": [
        {
          "accountableRole": "<string>",
          "blockingChecks": [],
          "canonicalGateId": "<string>",
          "evidenceResults": [
            {
              "artifact": "<string>",
              "found": "<boolean>",
              "passed": "<boolean>",
              "required": "<boolean>",
              "schemaValid": "<boolean>",
              "validationMessage": "<string>"
            }
          ],
          "gateId": "<string>",
          "name": "<string>",
          "opaRules": [
            "<string>"
          ],
          "passed": "<boolean>",
          "phase": "<number>",
          "waiverAuthority": "<string>",
          "waiverAvailable": "<boolean>"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "command": "evolith sdlc gate-status",
    "correlationId": "<string>",
    "durationMs": "<number>",
    "executedAt": "<string>",
    "schemaVersion": "1.0.0"
  },
  "success": true
}
```

#### MCP

| Argument | Type | Req. | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | ✓ | — |
